new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Formal anti-drug or anti-smuggling stories can sit above older financial infrastructures that profit from the trade being denounced, so the real target is what makes money rather than the public moral name of the operation.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The source links Venezuela, fentanyl, and opium-war finance into a reusable hidden-infrastructure claim, but the current evidence is too narrow and sensitive for a public page without cross-source grounding.

new_lens_seeds.title: Strategic Stillness
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A player can win by refusing premature motion: sitting back, defending, and letting a reckless enemy make the mistakes can be a strategy rather than passivity.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The interview gives a crisp China doctrine that may recur across Strategy, Game Theory, and Civilization sources.
new_lens_seeds.reason: The mechanism is useful but currently fits inside existing Game Theory and Strategy language. Do not publish unless later sources repeat stillness as a named reusable doctrine.
